chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from more than one of our companions from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Prayer on a ship is [performed by] nodding."
ai.seo_question: How is prayer performed on a ship according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of *rukhas* (divine concessions) in ritual purity and movement, specifically addressing the practical challenges of maritime travel. It clarifies that *ima'* (nodding) serves as a sufficient substitute for the full physical postures of *ruku'* and *sujdah* when the environment prevents their proper execution, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on ease (*yusr*) within the framework of obligation.
